entry.title: Νέα αμερικανική επίθεση σε τάνκερ στα ανοικτά του Ομάν
entry.summary: The US military announced a new strike on a tanker off Oman, near the Strait of Hormuz. The ship, carrying Iranian oil, was hit with Hellfire missiles after refusing to comply.

entry.title: Μήνυμα Γεραπετρίτη στην Αγκυρα: Οι μονομερείς οριοθετήσεις δεν έχουν καμία νομική ισχύ
entry.summary: FM Yorgos Gerapetritis warned Ankara that unilateral maritime delimitations have no legal force. Greece will not shape policy based on Turkey's draft bill on maritime zones.

entry.title: Ελληνοτουρκικά: Προχωράει με το νομοσχέδιο η Αγκυρα
entry.summary: Turkish FM Hakan Fidan told Gerapetritis that Ankara is proceeding with its 'Blue Homeland' maritime-zones bill. The issue is expected to become a friction point in the autumn, possibly during an election period.

entry.title: Ιρανός διοικητής αεροπορίας: Αν πειράξετε τα Στενά του Ορμούζ, θα τα μετατρέψουμε σε κόλαση
entry.summary: An Iranian IRGC air force commander threatened to turn the region into 'hell' if the US destabilizes the Strait of Hormuz. Iran announced a closure of the strait, which CENTCOM denied.

entry.title: Ελληνοτουρκικά: Σφοδρή αντίδραση της Αγκυρας για τη συμφωνία Κύπρου – Γαλλίας
entry.summary: Ankara reacted strongly to the France-Cyprus military forces agreement allowing French troops on the island. Turkey's defense ministry warned of 'dangerous consequences'.

entry.title: Η Τουρκία κάλεσε Ιράν και ΗΠΑ να σταματήσουν τις επιθέσεις
entry.summary: Turkey called on Iran and the US to stop mutual strikes after another night of bombing. Saudi Arabia condemned Iranian attacks on Jordan, Bahrain and Kuwait, urging de-escalation.

entry.title: Παραιτήθηκε ο γ.γ. του υπουργείου Πολιτισμού, Γιώργος Διδασκάλου
entry.summary: Culture ministry general secretary Yorgos Didaskalou resigned against the backdrop of the urban-planning ring. It follows the resignation of spatial-planning secretary Efthymios Bakoyannis.

entry.title: G7: Η σύνοδος κορυφής του Εβιάν στη σκιά του πολέμου
entry.summary: The G7 summit at Evian will be the first transatlantic meeting since the US-Israel war on Iran. Europeans will try to bridge the gap with Donald Trump over the Middle East and Ukraine.

entry.title: Απεξάρτηση από ρωσικό αέριο, κυριαρχία αμερικανικού LNG
entry.summary: LNG covered 64.3% of domestic gas demand in the first five months, cutting Russian gas to 24.4%. Greece is moving toward full independence from Russian gas by 2027, but at a higher cost.

entry.title: Μαρινάκης για κύκλωμα πολεοδομιών: «Αφήστε τον ρόλο του εισαγγελέα στους εισαγγελείς. Μη βιάζεστε»
entry.summary: Government spokesman Pavlos Marinakis declined to link two general-secretary resignations to the urban-planning bribery ring, urging that prosecutors be left to their work. He faced pressure from SYRIZA over officials' alleged involvement in graft.

entry.title: Παραιτήθηκε ο Βρετανός υπουργός Αμυνας Τζον Χίλι
entry.summary: UK Defence Secretary John Healey resigned over a disagreement on defense spending. He accused PM Keir Starmer and the Treasury of failing to provide the necessary resources.

entry.title: Ο τουρισμός αντισταθμίζει τις μέχρι τώρα επιπτώσεις της γεωπολιτικής κρίσης
entry.summary: Tourism offsets the effects of the geopolitical crisis, with GDP up 2% in the first quarter. Tourism revenue rose 64.3% and arrivals 38.3% year-on-year, according to the National Bank.

entry.title: Ε.Ε.: Ξεκινά η «μάχη» του ευρωπαϊκού προϋπολογισμού
entry.summary: The battle over the EU's next seven-year budget begins, with the Cyprus Presidency proposing cuts of about 2%. The plan protects cohesion and agriculture but is expected to draw reactions from 'frugal' states.

entry.title: Κρήτη: Μονόδρομος η δομή στο πρώην ΚΤΕΟ
entry.summary: Crete lacks a second migrant reception facility as the new EU pact takes effect, with 2,189 arrivals in June. Minister Thanos Plevris seeks to use the former Heraklion vehicle-inspection site, sparking local reactions.

entry.title: Είμαστε τόσο σίγουροι για την ανταγωνιστικότητα του τουρισμού;
entry.summary: Accommodation prices rose 11% in a single month while inflation stayed above 5%. Steep holiday-package hikes threaten the competitiveness of Greek tourism.

entry.title: ΠΑΣΟΚ: «Επιδημία» παραιτήσεων γενικών γραμματέων – Βαριά εκτεθειμένη η κυβέρνηση για το σκάνδαλο στις πολεοδομίες
entry.summary: PASOK accuses the government of an 'epidemic' of general-secretary resignations amid the urban-planning scandal. Spokesman Kostas Tsoukalas speaks of an 'industry producing political money'.

entry.title: Μόσχα: Οι πρέσβεις Γαλλίας, Γερμανίας και Βρετανίας κλήθηκαν στο ρωσικό ΥΠΕΞ
entry.summary: Moscow summoned the ambassadors of France, Germany and Britain to the Russian foreign ministry. The move follows the 'E3' leaders' meeting with Volodymyr Zelensky in London on a ceasefire.

entry.title: Εκρηκτικό κοκτέιλ στην αγορά συντηρεί την ακρίβεια
entry.summary: Greek statistics authority ELSTAT reported 5.2% annual inflation in May, driven by fuel, services and fresh food. Analysts warn that benefits without structural reforms sustain high prices.

entry.title: «Το πάλεψα, στο τσακ το ’φερα»: Πώς πέρασε το ακίνητο στα Πετράλωνα από το Συμβούλιο Νεωτέρων Μνημείων
entry.summary: New dimensions to the urban-planning ring, with a member of the Central Council of Modern Monuments among the accused. The involvement concerns the demolition of a property in Petralona.

entry.title: Παγκόσμια κούρσα για ενεργειακή αυτάρκεια
entry.summary: The naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz is pushing governments worldwide toward energy self-sufficiency. Countries turn to domestic resources, renewables, coal or nuclear, depending on the duration of the war in Iran.
